title: Reminder email test
description: Uses your saved reminder language and the actual reminder template, including email settings and unsubscribe links. Changing the website language has no effect. Save your reminder preference first. One test per saved language in this test window; it does not consume your automatic reminder.
accepted: Test reminder accepted in {language}. Check your inbox, Promotions and spam folders.
alreadySent: The {language} test was already sent in this test window. No new email was sent.
reminderDisabled: Save your reminder consent and language below before testing. Then try again.
failed: The test email could not be sent. Check that you are using the approved test account.
unknown: The sending result could not be confirmed. Check your inbox before trying again.
expired: This test has expired. A new authorized test is needed.
localeUnavailable: This test window uses another language. A new authorized test is needed for the selected language.
